title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression

Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo …

title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introdu…
description: Composed Image Retrieval, Multimodal Large Language Models, Factorized MLLM Embeddings, factorized latents, target imagination
developer_name: WonJun Moon, Seongchan Kim, Dahun Kim, Seungryong Kim

analysis.detail_brief: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications.

title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order…

summary_cn: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Lo：大型语言模型被部署为长视野代理，将跨 MCP 服务的各种工具组合成可执行的工作流程。现有的 MCP 环境扩展方法以数据为中心：它们首先综合数据库和场景，然后从中派生工具和任务。
